output_list.criticism: Allowing non-owners to transfer is extremely dangerous for the protocol and can be exploited by malicious users to transfer all the tokens, drain the contract, steal the tokens from users, etc.
The supply calculation in the mint function is incorrect, it does not increase the totalSupply. This can lead to wrong token balances and even loss of tokens.

The transfer function does not emit the transfer event that other ERC20 compatible tokens use to notify the blockchain of a transfer. It makes the token less useful to other platforms as they can't easily monitor this transfer.
The mint function is currently not checking if msg.sender is the minter (owner). This will allow anyone to mint token instead of the intended minter.
